html:
SMTO-LEG-0002 — Accept the license agreement to start new work

GUID: 8897bb5b-f5e2-49d7-870f-24eba450034e
Slug: eula-acceptance-required
Domain: LEG · Subsystem: leg

What happened

  • SMTO won't start new work until the current license agreement has been accepted on this server. Your request wasn't started, and nothing was run.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Select Review agreement in the banner above the message box, or open Settings, go to Licenses and legal, and select Accept current version. This server has no acceptance on record for the current agreement.
  2. Read the agreement, tick I have read and agree, then select I Agree & Continue if you choose to agree. SMTO needs your explicit yes; it never accepts the terms for you.
  3. If you accepted before, check whether SMTO was recently updated; compare Current version and Accepted version under Settings › Licenses and legal. An earlier acceptance covers only the version you accepted, not a changed agreement.
  4. If you started this from the command line, accept the agreement in the web app first, then run the command again. The command line checks the same acceptance record as the web app.

What success looks like

  • The banner disappears, Settings › Licenses and legal shows the Accepted version equal to the Current version, and new work starts.

If it still fails

  • If you can't or don't want to accept, new work stays unavailable; select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't accept on behalf of someone who hasn't read the terms.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Task admission was refused because the local controller has no acceptance record for the current EULA version and hash, or the accept request did not carry agree=true.

What this means

  • Automation admission finds no acceptance record for the current agreement, or the acceptance input lacks the required affirmative true value. These are product document-identity and admission checks. Diagnostics neither accept terms for a user nor change agreement/acceptance records; publisher defects require publisher repair.

Why this can happen

  • Automation admission finds no acceptance record for the current agreement, or the acceptance input lacks the required affirmative true value.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the current agreement identity and acceptance state; prior acceptance of different terms does not apply.

How to fix it

  • EulaService.require and acceptance() in src/agent_runtime/legal/service.py found no legal_eula_acceptance row for the current SMTO_EULA_VERSION and document hash (task start and the CLI _require_eula both check it). A user must accept through the UI, which posts agree=true to /api/legal/eula/accept; check GET /api/legal/eula/status and never insert acceptance rows by hand.
  • Open the current agreement through the existing review flow and accept it only if you choose to agree. A previous document’s acceptance does not accept a changed agreement.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The user has reviewed and affirmatively accepted the current agreement through its normal flow if they choose to proceed.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • These are product document-identity and admission checks. Diagnostics neither accept terms for a user nor change agreement/acceptance records; publisher defects require publisher repair.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
